sonnet.problem: The choice hangs on the meaning of the hard word 'Rabboni'. Nothing on the earlier cards (card 11 only says Jesus says 'Mary') lets a baker reason out 'Teacher' over 'King' or 'Savior', so a correct pick comes down to luck.
sonnet.rule: The check: could a thoughtful baker who has only seen the earlier cards make a reasoned pick? If the only way to get it right is luck, give the story card more context or ask a different question.
